comment: REVIEW 2026-10-22 item 2 (reviewer repro shock_equip): 'cast Kor Duelist (off the Plains), play Temple Garden, equip Bonesplitter'. The deferred shock land's pay-2-life rule counted only casts / retraces / digs AFTER the land, so the later PAID equip was missed: the Garden entered tapped, the equip could not be paid and the Duelist attacked for 1. It now counts every mana-spending step after the land (HumanStepSpendsMana): the Garden enters untapped (20 -> 18), pays the equip, and the equipped Duelist hits for 6 (20 -> 14) -- the same as the land-first control (kitty_human_seq_shock_land_first_control).
